# IP Info

> Free, public network toolbox at https://ip-info.leunos.com. It shows your public IPv4/IPv6 address and provides bounded checks against public internet targets only: IP/domain lookup, ASN, DNS, WHOIS, CDN detection, ping/port checks, and IP reputation.

Supported interface languages: Deutsch, English, Español, Français, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski, Português (Brasil), Português (Portugal), 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Українська, 简体中文, 繁體中文, العربية, हिन्दी, Bahasa Indonesia, Čeština, Svenska, Dansk, Norsk bokmål, Suomi, Ελληνικά, Română, Türkçe.

The tools run through server-side Next.js API routes. Inputs are validated with Zod and checked against SSRF protections before network access; private and internal targets are rejected. Public routes are rate-limited with an in-memory token bucket per client IP. The site has no user accounts and does not permanently store request data. An explicit language choice is stored in the functional `ip-info-locale` cookie and in browser local storage; the theme preference is stored in local storage as well.

## Tools

- [Show my IP](https://ip-info.leunos.com/): Public IPv4/IPv6 address with available location, provider, ASN, reverse DNS, and connection details.
- [IP/domain lookup](https://ip-info.leunos.com/check): Public IP address or domain metadata.
- [ASN lookup](https://ip-info.leunos.com/asn): ASN identity, announced prefixes, routing relationships, and public PeeringDB data; deep links use `/asn/AS123`.
- [Ping & port test](https://ip-info.leunos.com/ping): Bounded TCP/UDP reachability, endpoint, and selected database checks.
- [DNS lookup](https://ip-info.leunos.com/dns): A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, SRV, CAA, and reverse PTR records.
- [WHOIS lookup](https://ip-info.leunos.com/whois): WHOIS/RDAP registration, registrar, nameserver, and date fields.
- [CDN check](https://ip-info.leunos.com/cdn): DNS, CNAME, HTTP, and provider signals for public domains.
- [IP reputation](https://ip-info.leunos.com/reputation): Evidence-based risk and source analysis using independent reputation and threat-intelligence sources.

## JSON API

The public JSON endpoints are rate-limited and return the standard `{ ok, data }` / `{ ok, error }` envelope.

- `/api/ip`: Public IP metadata (80 requests/minute).
- `/api/asn/{asn}`: ASN and routing data (30/minute).
- `/api/dns?target=`: DNS records for a domain (40/minute).
- `/api/whois?target=`: WHOIS/RDAP data (20/minute).
- `/api/cdn?target=`: CDN signals for a domain (20/minute).
- `/api/ping`: TCP/UDP reachability, POST (20/minute).
- `/api/reputation?ip=`: Reputation and source analysis (20/minute).
